title: Next Generation Scientist Program 2027 (Novartis and University of Basel)
organization: Novartis, with the University of Basel
overview: A 3-month research internship and leadership programme at the Novartis research site in Basel, Switzerland, from 1 June to 31 August 2027, for MSc, PhD and MD students enrolled at universities in low- and middle-income countries. Interns work on a scientific, clinical research or global health project with a Novartis mentor. Novartis pays a monthly stipend for incidentals and basic living expenses.
deadline_text: Posted 15 October 2026; the Novartis Workday posting REQ-10089124 carries the structured data "datePosted": "2026-10-15" and "validThrough": "2026-11-15" (read 2 November 2026 in the page's own data, and again in the rerun), and still accepts applications. No closing time is stated. Opportunity Desk also reports a 15 November 2026 deadline.
funding_details: Novartis: "Novartis will provide a monthly stipend to cover incidentals and basic living expenses." No amount is stated (the posting's salary field shows CHF 0.00 - CHF 0.00).
Flights, visa, accommodation and insurance are not mentioned on the posting.
stipend: Monthly stipend for incidentals and basic living expenses (amount not stated)
experience_requirement: No work experience is listed; applicants must be enrolled as MSc, PhD or MD students
education_requirement: "Enrolled at university as MSc, PhD or MD student in a geography of scope (low- and middle-income country)"
nationality_requirements: Enrolled at a university in a low- or middle-income country ("geography of scope"); the list of countries in scope is not given on the posting
language_requirement: "Advanced verbal and written English communication skills"
eligibility: Enrolled as an MSc, PhD or MD student at a university in a low- or middle-income country
Active participation in all programme and training activities

Preferred fields: translational science, clinical development and global health (therapeutic areas include cardiovascular disease, oncology, infectious diseases such as malaria and leishmaniasis, and sickle cell disease)
application_process: Apply through the Novartis careers site (Workday) for REQ-10089124 before 15 November 2026

title: UNICEF DRC internships (Kinshasa, Goma, Bunia)
overview: Six-month internships in the UNICEF DRC country office. The 2026 round included Information Management and Monitoring & Evaluation interns in Kinshasa, a PSEA associate intern in Goma and an Administration intern in Bunia.
deadline_text: The 2026 round closed on 25 May 2026. Searches of jobs.unicef.org on 2 November 2026 ('congo', 'intern') showed no internship in the DRC: DRC results were a Supply Associate temporary post and consultancies only; the internships listed were in other countries (for example Senegal and the Central African Republic).
expected_next_cycle: No new UNICEF DRC internship call on jobs.unicef.org on 2 November 2026. UNICEF posts internship calls there.
funding_details: The Goma PSEA post states it is paid according to UNICEF DRC policy; other posts were not read.
age_requirement: 20 to 30 (stated on the Goma PSEA post only)
education_requirement: At least second-year university student, or graduated within the last 2 years (Goma PSEA post)
language_requirement: Excellent French; English or local languages preferred
eligibility: Currently in at least the second year of university, or graduated within the last two years (PSEA post)
